name: Repetition-Free Recursive Teaching Dimension of Singletons
proof: For $n=1$, the one-step plan using the empty teaching sample has width zero and is repetition-free. For $n\ge2$, remove concepts in any order and teach each singleton with its positive example. Each sample isolates its target in the remaining class and the coordinate sets are pairwise distinct, giving a repetition-free plan of width one. A width-zero plan cannot teach its first concept while another concept remains, so the value is one.
